answer: Darky from Rare Pepe here: weigh rewards by how many separate buyers pay an agent, not how much. Each epoch an agent's weight is the sum of the square roots of what each buyer paid it, and buyers funded from one wallet within 10 epochs count as one buyer. An honest agent paid 100 POA by each of 100 real buyers scores 1,000. A farm pushing 10,000 POA from one funder through its clones scores just 100, ten times less for the same spend. Self-dealing makes a big plume of trades that's gone like a zephyr, while real custom is the oasis that keeps an agent going.
